display.purpose: The developer's name on the public profile only.

headline.purpose: One h1 per workspace page; document headings on paper use it spaced out.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, meta lines.

measure.purpose: Running clock, hours, document numbers, dates in dense lists.

shadows.name: paper-on-desk
shadows.purpose: The client's document lying on the dark desk; the only object that casts a shadow.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: A square filling from the bottom (scaleY).

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: 칸 채우기: a calendar day stepping up a level. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a view (타이머 시작, 입금 확인, 견적서 만들기).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid oklch(0.74 0.15 74); border-radius:3px; background:oklch(0.74 0.15 74); color:oklch(0.2 0.03 70); font:600 13px/1.2 'Pretendard Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:oklch(0.8 0.15 80); border-color:oklch(0.8 0.15 80); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.89 0.15 95); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Everything that is not the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid oklch(0.4 0.016 255); border-radius:3px; background:transparent; color:oklch(0.94 0.008 255); font:600 13px/1.2 'Pretendard Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:oklch(0.24 0.014 255); border-color:oklch(0.66 0.014 255); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.89 0.15 95); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions; always followed by an inline confirm row.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.72 0.15 18) 45%, transparent); border-radius:3px; background:transparent; color:oklch(0.72 0.15 18); font:600 13px/1.2 'Pretendard Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:oklch(0.32 0.08 18); border-color:oklch(0.72 0.15 18); color:oklch(0.94 0.008 255); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.89 0.15 95); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Sunk well with a label above and error below.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; } .ds-label { color:oklch(0.78 0.012 255); font:600 12px/1.4 'Pretendard Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height:36px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid oklch(0.3 0.014 255); border-radius:3px; background:oklch(0.155 0.011 255); color:oklch(0.94 0.008 255); font:400 14px/1.4 'Pretendard Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:oklch(0.4 0.016 255); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:oklch(0.74 0.15 74); outline:2px solid oklch(0.89 0.15 95); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: State Label
components.description: Every status: a square that fills plus its Korean label.
components.html: 발행 입금대기 입금완료 기한 4일 지남
components.css: .ds-state { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; margin-right:14px; color:oklch(0.94 0.008 255); font:600 13px/1.2 'Pretendard Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cell { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:2px; } .ds-hollow { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px oklch(0.4 0.016 255); } .ds-partial { background:linear-gradient(to top, oklch(0.74 0.15 74) 50%, transparent 50%); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px oklch(0.74 0.15 74); } .ds-solid { background:oklch(0.74 0.15 74); } .ds-warn { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px oklch(0.72 0.15 18); }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Square + label + mono count; the current square fills amber.
components.html: 프로젝트4견적 · 청구2수익
components.css: .ds-rail { display:grid; gap:2px; width:200px; padding:8px; background:oklch(0.205 0.013 255); } .ds-rail-link { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:34px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:3px; color:oklch(0.78 0.012 255); font:550 14px/1.2 'Pretendard Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-rail-link:hover { background:oklch(0.24 0.014 255); color:oklch(0.94 0.008 255); } .ds-rail-link[aria-current] { background:oklch(0.24 0.014 255); color:oklch(0.94 0.008 255); font-weight:650; } .ds-rail-cell { width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:2px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px oklch(0.4 0.016 255); } .ds-rail-link[aria-current] .ds-rail-cell { background:oklch(0.74 0.15 74); box-shadow:none; } .ds-count { margin-left:auto; color:oklch(0.66 0.014 255); font:500 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-rail-link[aria-current] .ds-count { color:oklch(0.89 0.15 95); }

components.name: Work Calendar Week
components.description: Signature: Monday-first day cells in five levels; today ringed; deposit tick under the week.
components.css: .ds-cal { display:grid; grid-template-rows:repeat(7, 22px); gap:3px; width:22px; } .ds-cal span { border-radius:2px; } .l0 { background:oklch(0.26 0.012 255); } .l1 { background:oklch(0.38 0.055 60); } .l2 { background:oklch(0.53 0.1 64); } .l3 { background:oklch(0.74 0.15 74); } .l4 { background:oklch(0.89 0.15 95); } .today { box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px oklch(0.94 0.008 255); } .ds-tick { width:22px; height:5px; margin-top:3px; border-radius:1px; background:oklch(0.89 0.15 95); }

components.name: Paper Amount Box
components.description: The client's document: amount spelled in Korean words in a ruled box.
components.css: .ds-sheet { padding:28px; border-radius:2px; background:#fff; color:oklch(0.22 0.014 255); box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .08), 0 24px 48px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / .7); font:400 13px/1.6 'Pretendard Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-amount { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:baseline; gap:4px 12px; margin:0; padding:12px 16px; border:1.5px solid oklch(0.22 0.014 255); } .ds-amount-label { color:oklch(0.5 0.014 255); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; } .ds-amount strong { font-size:16px; font-weight:750; }

narrative.overview:
DevFlow is the business side of a Korean solo developer, drawn in the grammar of the contribution calendar the developer already reads every day. Every unit of work or money is a square that fills: a day of hours in the work calendar, an hour of an estimate in a project's hour run, a milestone, an invoice, a tenth of this month's goal. Hollow means opened, half-filled means in motion, solid means done or paid; a rose outline means late. The square is the only ornament the system allows, and it always carries data.

The workspace is a graphite night desk, used after a coding block beside a dark editor: two cool neutral layers, hairline rules, dense ruled lists and tables with tabular numerals, square-cornered controls. One heat ramp, dim copper → amber → sodium yellow, is spent only on data and on the single primary action. What the client sees — 견적서, 청구서 and the public profile — flips to the paper register: a white sheet, graphite ink, the same ramp read from pale to deep copper, the amount spelled out in Korean words and a square 도장 stamped when the money arrives.
keyCharacteristics: The contribution calendar is the first viewport: 26 or 52 weeks of Monday-first day cells, sized from the container, capped at 30px.
State is a fill level (hollow / partial / solid / rose outline), always paired with a text label.
Dark desk for the developer, white paper for the client; the two never mix on one surface except as a sheet on the desk.
Money and hours are exact: tabular numerals, JetBrains Mono for measured values only.
Regions are separated by hairlines and whitespace, not boxed cards; panels appear only for a form or a single summary.

rules.name: The Data-Only Ramp Rule
rules.body: Copper, amber and sodium appear only where they encode hours, fill state, money or the one primary action on screen. No amber headings, borders or backgrounds for emphasis.

rules.name: The Label-With-Every-Square Rule
rules.body: A state square is never alone: 입금대기, 기한 4일 지남, 완료 always sit beside it in text.

rules.name: The Measured-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: If it is not a clock, an hour count, a date in a dense list or a document number, it is Pretendard.

rules.name: The Paper-Is-The-Only-Object Rule
rules.body: Only the client's document casts a shadow; everything else in the workspace is a layer, not an object.

dos: Do express every status as a square plus its Korean label.
Do keep amber for data and the one primary action; let everything else be graphite.
Do separate regions with 1px rules and space; reach for a panel only to hold a form or a single summary.
Do use tabular numerals for all money, and JetBrains Mono only for measured values.
Do show the client-facing register on white paper, never dark.
donts: Don't add stat-card grids with big numbers and small labels; facts sit in ruled definition lists.
Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings, gradient text, glow halos or glass panels.
Don't round anything past 3px or use pills and circles.
Don't use colour alone for state, and don't use rose for anything that is not late, over, invalid or destructive.
